item.title: Digitalisation News Brief — 2026-11-11
item.description:
1. [Tech News] Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”

2. [Tech News] Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share to reach an implied valuation of $1.404 trillion
The company could end up being worth a hefty $1.404 trillion if its shares list at the top of the price range, on a fully diluted basis.

3. [Tech News] After challenging Google’s Android with Cyanogen, its co-founder takes aim at Windows for AI era
Kora is set to launch as a free-to-use alternative to Windows, targeting users who rely heavily on AI models and agents.

4. [Tech News] Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion IPO

5. [Tech News] Reddit launches AI-powered Reviews feature – with 10,000 products to start
Reddit is adding AI-generated product reviews that compile real user sentiment from across communities. Here’s how they work.
